meta.title: Temporal workflow replay
meta.summary: A worker crashes mid-workflow and another resumes by replaying event history.

steps.title: Start workflow
steps.narration: The client starts a workflow. The server records a `WorkflowStarted` event and hands a task to Worker A.

steps.title: Activity completes
steps.narration: Worker A runs the workflow code, which schedules an activity. The result is **appended** to history before the workflow moves on.

steps.title: Worker A crashes
steps.narration: Worker A dies mid-workflow. It held local variables, but they do not matter: history is the source of truth, not worker memory.

steps.title: Worker B takes over
steps.narration: The server times out Worker A's task and schedules it on Worker B, which has never seen this workflow.

steps.title: Replay history
steps.narration: Worker B **replays** the workflow code against the recorded events. `ChargeCard` is not run again; its recorded result is returned instead.

steps.title: Continue where it stopped
steps.narration: Replay catches Worker B up to the crash point, and then it executes new work, appending to the same history.
